environment.description: Application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with no header manipulation. CACHE_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is unset (empty string). The ELB passes all headers including Host directly to the application without normalization. No CDN or reverse proxy in front. Security groups allow direct internet access on port 8080 as well.

config.network: Public subnet, SG allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 8080 and 80
